x: He had had a stern struggle with Schwab in Berlin the previous Sunday, which may have had an effect upon his walking, but it remains a strange fact that Green, who has achieved so many successes at varying distances, is still unable to win the 20 miles Championship.

Green has been busy on Continental travels lately and defeated the European champion and record-holder, Schwab, by a stride after a neck and neck struggle for the whole of the 27 kilos (about 16 miles).

Familiar names to appear include Laisné (France), Schwab (Germany), Dalinsch (Latvia) and Mikaelson (Sweden). The standard appears to be very high, and we look forward to the time when international team walks are an accepted part of our programme.
